review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scopes, evidence stages and task keys agree with the original PRD. The source establishes core/api.ts as the shared parameter and decode-transform owner; classic/mini factories, normalization and exports already forward the shared contract and appropriately remain inspection owners. The build configuration supports generated declarations rather than separately maintained declaration owners. The specified decode-only trimming, unchanged vocabulary whitespace, existing case normalization and encode first-entry/empty-entry fallback semantics are consistent with the baseline source. Both regression paths are within scope and included by the supplied test/typecheck configurations; runtime compilation mode is not mistaken for TypeScript checking. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The permitted implementer and verifier have matching delivery roles, auto-assignable memberships, available capacity and active trusted claims for the bounded work, including data.change and the verifier-only testing.verification claim; pending legacy claims and personas are not used as substitutes. A separate configured reviewer is present for the stated earlier review prerequisite. No material unresolved DEC-001 is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved material decision in B would instead block at decisions, and a fixed hypothetical C would not constitute a human Decision. The release fingerprints match between Gold and preview, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and PRD persistence normalization. Historical operations are explicitly retained as old-bundle history, not candidate evidence for this bundle. The original specification's preparation-time remaining/null fields are distinguishable from the supplied frozen release inputs and this pending independent review. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound digest and isolation evidence; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, attest human actions, or evaluate any candidate.
